Name: Additional Farm Cave
Author: tikamin557
Description:
The new areas function like a greenhouse.
Forest spirits also bring forageable items every day.
Stones, copper ore, and geodes can appear at random.
(An optional file is also available that changes the ores produced based on your Mining level.)

The deeper area also allows you to use Casks.
You can find four Casks in a treasure chest, letting you start using them a little earlier if you reach this area before upgrading your farmhouse.
If you enable the Minecart option in the mod's configuration, a minecart will appear on the map. You can use it just like the minecarts in the base game once you've met the normal unlock requirements.

[color=#00ffff][size=4]Area Theme[/size][/color]
You can change the appearance of the first additional area using the "Area Theme" option in GMCM.
When set to "Default", the area's appearance will automatically match the cave from a compatible Farm Cave mod, if one is installed.

[color=#00ffff]Area Unlock Requirements[/color]
[spoiler][size=4][color=#f4f4f4]・ [/color][color=#ff0000]1st Area[/color][/size]
Reach 2 hearts of friendship with Demetrius.
Reach 3 hearts of friendship with Robin.
Watch the event where Demetrius asks you to choose between mushrooms and fruit bats for the Farm Cave.
Once all three conditions are met, you'll receive a letter from Robin.
Reading the letter will unlock the first area.

[size=4][color=#f4f4f4]・[/color][/size][color=#00ff00][size=4] 2nd Area[/size][/color]
Visit the first area at least once.
Ship 5 bottles of wine or juice.
Once both conditions are met, an event will trigger when you enter the Farm between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM.
After that, another event will trigger when you enter the first area, unlocking access to the second area[/spoiler]
